name: Football Duels [WR VS CB] ANIMATIONS!
desc:
🏈 The American football CATCHING game! Win 1v1 WR vs CB duels, climb Ranked, play QB and squad up for 2v2 & 3v3 football in the Park.

• Brand-new map & stadium

• New ball skins, trails, auras & catch effects
• Stats reset for Season 1: everyone starts even!

⭐ MODES
1v1 Duels · Ranked · Elimination · King of the Hill · Toss · Lob · 2v2 · 3v3 · WR vs DB
